Third: Reconciliation 2.0 floor vote slipped past the June 1 Senate target — Senate returned at 3 PM with only judicial cloture votes; next window is the week of June 8. The Iran deal holds: CBS News reports Trump personally edited the MOU text on enrichment uranium and Hormuz provisions — a principal-level engagement signal, not collapse — but both Trump and Khamenei remain unsigned at Day 4 of the dual-principal approval gap. FEMA enters hurricane season 2026 shorthanded — CNN investigation confirms Noem/Lewandowski blocked $15B and drove out 20% of workforce, opening an 8–14 storm season with elevated major-hurricane risk from warm sea surface temperatures. Longview paper mill recovery complete (all 11 bodies recovered); Columbia River contamination and investigation ongoing. Portland City Council reconvened June 1 (budget T-30; June 3 amendments). Vibe 3 holds. The week ahead: June 2–3 Israel-Lebanon talks (T-1 tonight), June 3 Portland City Council amendments, June 3–4 US Infrastructure Development Conference (Dallas), week of June 8 Reconciliation 2.0 next window, and the compound NIFC above-normal fire potential entering the temporary early-June green-up moderation period before July escalation onset.
